blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has arrested two siblings who allegedly used the names of lawyers to conduct “falsified” notarial services in Makati City. In an interview on Wednesday, NBI spokesperson Palmer Mallari said the suspects, a 20-year-old woman and a 31-year-old man from Taguig City, had been operating the fake notarial service at a makeshift tent along Kamagong Extension in Barangay San Antonio, Makati City. “This is a small place. There is a sign that says “notary public.” But for notarizing an affidavit of loss, they charge only P100. Aside from this, they found that those […]...
